fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: This program aims at preparing students for pharmacy services, education and research in pharmacy-related fields, and drug research and development. Students in this program study the basic knowledge and practical skills in pharmacy and clinical pharmacy. The program provides students with basic training in clinical pharmacy research methods and practical skills, and enables students command the basic knowledge and skills in clinical pharmacy, drug evaluation (new drug evaluation and drug re-evaluation), pharmaceutical information and consulting services, design and practice of clinical drug treatment. The program is designed to prepare students for pharmacy services, education and research in pharmacy-related fields, and drug research and development. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The key courses which will be instructed in the 4 years are listed in the table. Course Offering 3. Experimental Training Center Editor Notes: The National Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center of Pharmacy of the school has greatly promoted the experimental teaching level of pharmacy/traditional Chinese Medicine nationwide. Practical ability is the core competence for pharmacy students. School of Pharmacy encourages students to participate in extracurricular innovative research projects, taking advantage of the National Experimental Teaching Demonstration Center of Pharmacy, the National Experimental Teaching Center for Pharmacy Stimulation, the National Innovative Talent Training Zone, the Innovative Program for College Students, National Teaching Team, and the Experimental Bilingual Teaching Program. Increasing investment has been given to the experimental centers, which has been playing an exemplary role nationwide of the system of management and experimental teaching reform. Strengthen the foundation of experimental teaching to build fist-class education platform. School of Pharmacy has an area of 6000 square meters for experiments and teaching, equipped with advanced large-scale instruments and equipments such as LC/MS and multimedia facilities, with fixed assets valued about 80 million RMB. 4. About China Pharmaceutical University (CPU) Editor Notes: Its pharmacy program ranks No. 1 in China. China Pharmaceutical University (CPU), situated in the historical and cultural city of Nanjing, is one of the "211 project" key universities affiliated to the Ministry of Education of China. It has been known for its long history and its leadership role in China's pharmaceutical academic field. The University was founded in 1936 as China's first independent four-year National College of Pharmacy and the first public institution for higher pharmaceutical education in China. Learn More>> 5. Colourful Life Editor Notes: More colourful activities are waiting for you to explore. Sports Meeting Graduation Ceremony

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Application Form Please upload your finished application form here. * 2. Certificate of no criminal record, which should be issued within 6 months prior to the submission of the application. * 3. Bank deposit certificate or income proof of the financial guarantor. * 4. Study plan (over 600 words, written in English for English-taught programs). * 5. Resume detailing learning and work experience since high school. * 6. Foreigner Physical Examination Form "Foreigner Physical Examination Form", which must be filled out in English and examined strictly according to the items listed in the form. Physical examination results after November 1, 2024, will be considered valid. * 7. Scanned copy of the first page of the passport (valid ordinary passport with an expiration date after March 1) For applicants who were originally Chinese citizens but later acquired foreign nationality, or applicants holding foreign passports but with one or both parents as Chinese citizens, they also need to provide proof of the applicant's naturalization time, proof of renunciation of Chinese nationality, or foreign birth certificate, as well as scanned copies of visa records for entering and exiting China in the past four years. * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. Scan of notarized copy of the high school academic transcripts or scan of international standardization test results. Such as SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB etc. Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 10. Scan of original high school diploma or original notarized diploma. Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Scan of pre-graduation certificate is required if the applicants have not gained certificate. Please resubmit the original highest diploma or original notarized diploma before registration. * 11. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality: Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens . For those who were originally Chinese citizens and later joined the foreign nationality, our school implements No. 12 Announcement of the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China (2020). 2. Age: Applicants must be between 18 and 25 years old and have graduated from high school. Applicants who are still under the age of 18 as of September 1 of the year of enrollment need to submit the original notarial certificate of the guardian issued by the Nanjing District Notary Office, and the guardian must be a permanent resident of Nanjing. Applicants should have good character, good physical and mental health, and be willing to abide by Chinese laws and regulations and the rules and regulations of China Pharmaceutical University. 3. Language ability: Applicants who apply to teach in English must have an English level of IELTS6.5 or TOEFL90 or Duolingo 110 or above . 4. CSCA subjects requirements: ​​
